content.text: {"message":"キャラクター用の単体ミニチュア装甲を作成します。指定の寸法60x40x75mm以内で、先端が細く前後に湾曲し、表面に2本の波状の盛り上がった紋様を持つ青灰色の自由形状部品を作成します。","changes":[{"path":"scene","value":"object"},{"path":"program.upsert","value":{"id":"model-1","name":"湾曲装甲","x":0,"y":0,"color":"#4a6073","size":[60,40,75],"source":"const rings=[];for(let j=0;j<17;j++){const t=j/16;const ring=[];const width=4+22*Math.sin(Math.PI*(0.1+0.85*t));for(let i=0;i<24;i++){const a=i*2*Math.PI/24;const radius=30+width*Math.cos(a)-5*t*10;const z=70*t;const yOff=8+22*t*t+3*Math.sin(a);const xOff=(radius-30)*Math.sin(Math.PI*t*5);ring.push([30+(radius-30)*Math.cos(a),yOff-10+Math.sin(t*6)*4,z]);}rings.push(ring);}let armor=loft(rings);for(let side=0;side<2;side++){const path=[];for(let j=0;j<18;j++){const t=0.12+0.75*j/17;path.push([30+(side===0?-1:1)*8*Math.sin(Math.PI*t),8+22*t*t-2.4,70*t]);}armor=union(armor,tube(path,1.5));}armor=scale(armor,[60/60,40/40,75/75]);return armor;"}}]}
